row.title: Owner-owned kernel registries are protected paths
row.body: Chosen over CODEOWNERS review because project rules allow no human review. The EV registry, step repertoire, partitions, kernel9 map and kernel pin now fail the protected-path gate unless a PR carries a Protected-change line. The fast loop and executor cannot edit them; the slow-loop identity gated by replay and rollback is the only other writer (to build).
